# Prepared question controls

Task 123 preserves the accepted Task 122 source/emitted vectors from merge
`7320aae048a7cba06e4835b70477f9f21ffff771` before implementation. No existing application
source change is planned. New internal modules own preparation, immutable bounded
serialization, compact rendering and original-based witness validation; no HTTP/UI,
answer dispatch or schema is activated.

The two retained offline modules are semantic comparison controls only, without the
copied producer, method instrumentation or reserved library factory. Production uses
actual Task 122 services and separately named production versions. Ordinary tests may
compare controls after explicitly accounting for those version strings. They must not
rewrite the exhausted experiment's files, receipts or outcomes.

One store owns one active/ready slot and one bounded tombstone. Ready content is retained
as context/witness JSON strings, never a mutable caller graph. Source boundary callbacks
clear it eagerly; review and current source-build checks precede every ready access where
no callback exists. Code inventory replacement alone remains allowed. Future synchronous
promotion receives the exact held strings; callback failure keeps an otherwise valid
ready record. Answer/configuration coordination is an internal capability only until
its separate integration task wires the actual consumers.
